# hush_statsig_access_privilege (Resource)

Manage Statsig access privileges in the Hush Security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A server secret key limited to production
resource "hush_statsig_access_privilege" "example" {
  name         = "statsig-server-production"
  description  = "Server SDK key for production"
  key_type     = "server"
  environments = ["production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Statsig access privilege

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Statsig access privilege
- `environments` (Set of String) The Statsig environments the key works in. Unset means every environment. Statsig refuses an environment the project does not have
- `key_type` (String) The kind of Statsig key to mint: `server` (a server secret key, the default) or `client` (a client API key)
- `secondary_target_app_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of further Statsig target apps the key is limited to
- `target_app_id` (String) The ID of the Statsig target app the key is limited to. Unset means every target app

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Statsig access privilege
- `type` (String) The type of access privilege
